name: ALL Mode Iteration Bugs - PRD Mismatch and Output Capture
description: Multiple bugs in ALL mode iteration flow: (1) Iteration summary shows wrong PRD because get_active_prd returns first alphabetically, not the PRD Claude actually worked on. (2) generate_tests_for_completed_prds outputs display text to stdout which gets captured instead of just the count, causing syntax error. (3) Test generation still not creating files despite BUG-004 fix.

userStories.title: Fix PRD mismatch in iteration summary
userStories.description: As a developer using ALL mode, I want the iteration summary to show the correct PRD that was actually worked on, not the first alphabetically
acceptanceCriteria: display_iteration_summary looks up which PRD contains the story_id from STORY_DONE
New helper function find_prd_by_story_id searches all PRDs for matching story ID
Iteration summary shows correct PRD name, acceptance criteria, and checkbox status
Falls back to get_active_prd if story_id not found in any PRD

userStories.title: Fix output capture in generate_tests_for_completed_prds
userStories.description: As a developer, I want test generation to complete without syntax errors so the archiving flow works correctly
acceptanceCriteria: run_test_generation outputs display text to stderr (>&2) not stdout
generate_tests_for_completed_prds only outputs the count to stdout
Display banners still visible to user during test generation

userStories.title: Diagnose and fix test file generation
userStories.description: As a developer completing PRDs, I want regression tests to actually be created so the feature works as documented
acceptanceCriteria: Investigate why --dangerously-skip-permissions still results in 'Test files: 0'
Verify Claude receives the test generation prompt correctly
Verify Claude has permission to write to fade/tests/PRD-xxx/
Test files are actually created after ALL_COMPLETE

userStories.title: Add integration test for ALL mode flow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a test that validates the ALL mode iteration flow so these regressions are caught
acceptanceCriteria: Test verifies iteration summary shows correct PRD for completed story
Test verifies test generation completes without syntax errors
Test can be run manually via fade/tests/run.sh

technicalNotes.bug1_fix: Create find_prd_by_story_id() that searches fade/prd.json, prd.json, fade/prds/*.json, prds/*.json for story ID match
technicalNotes.bug2_location: bin/fade-cli run_test_generation() lines 1120-1193 - all echo statements need >&2
technicalNotes.bug2_fix: Change echo statements in run_test_generation to use >&2, keep only final count on stdout
bug3_investigation: Check if claude --dangerously-skip-permissions actually allows file writes
Check if the prompt is being passed correctly via stdin
Check if Claude is outputting TESTS_GENERATED signal
May need to use 'claude --print' for prompt but different approach for file creation
technicalNotes.reproduction: Run 'fade yolo' with multiple PRDs in queue, observe iteration summary shows wrong PRD and syntax error on ALL_COMPLETE
